Title: Verify GET /posts returns 200 with a non-empty JSON array of posts
Precondition: The API endpoint https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts is reachable from the test environment.
Steps: 1. Send an HTTP GET request to https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts. → Expected: The endpoint accepts the request and returns an HTTP response — status code, headers and body — that the assertions below validate. | 2. Assert that response status is 200. → Expected: The response status code is exactly 200. | 3. Assert that header "content-type" contains "application/json". → Expected: The "content-type" response header is present and contains "application/json". | 4. Assert that JSON body is a non-empty array. → Expected: The response body is an array containing at least one item.
Expected Result: All 3 assertions pass — response status is 200; header "content-type" contains "application/json"; JSON body is a non-empty array.
